topics.title: 课程作业与书面评估
topics.statusLabel: 教师自主决定（通识课程禁止起草）
topics.summary: 香港中文大学将生成式 AI 政策交由任课教师决定。在崇基学院通识课程（GECC3130/4130，2026/27学年）中执行模式二：严禁使用 AI 起草，仅允许拼写/语法检查（须经教务会通识委员会批准），且 AI 指数 > 25% 可能导致课程不及格。
topics.scope: 香港中文大学本科生与研究生课程；具体规则由任课教师及学院制定。
actions: 查阅每门课程大纲的具体 AI 规定
在模式二下严禁使用 AI 起草作业
按照课程指引注明任何获准的 AI 辅助

claims.text: GECC4130 Senior Seminar Course Outline 2026/27 | Chung Chi College, CUHK

evidence.quote:
Approach 2 (i.e. “Use only with prior permission”) is adopted for Chung Chi College General
Education courses (the revised approach is subject to approval by the Senate Committee on General Education).
Students are not allowed to use generative AI (GenAI) tools to prepare or write any part of their written assignments,
such as proposals, essays, or project reports. However, students may use GenAI tools solely for spelling and grammar
checking. In addition, students are strongly discouraged from using GenAI tools to generate summaries or paraphrases
as a substitute for close reading of the core texts. Students may also be asked to engage in interactions with GenAI tools
under teachers’ strict supervision.

claims.text: GECC4130 Senior Seminar Course Outline 2026/27 | Chung Chi College, CUHK

evidence.quote:
With each assignment, students will be required to submit a signed declaration that they are aware of these policies,
regulations, guidelines and procedures.
 For group projects of GECC4130, all students of the same group should be asked to sign the declaration, each of
whom is responsible and liable to disciplinary actions should there be any plagiarized contents in the group project,
irrespective of whether he/she has signed the declaration and whether he/she has contributed directly or indirectly to
the plagiarized contents.
 For assignments in the form of a computer-generated document that is principally text-based and submitted via
VeriGuide, the statement, in the form of a receipt, will be issued by the system upon students' uploading of the soft
copy of the assignment.
 Students are fully aware that their work may be investigated by AI content detection software to determine originality.
Assignments without the properly signed declaration will not be graded by teachers.

topics.title: 数据隐私与机密保护
topics.statusLabel: 严禁上传敏感或专有数据

使用中大账号并核对企业数据保护标识；不可因品牌或标识推定已获审批。

claims.text: A CUHK student may lodge a written appeal with full justifications against a first-instance disciplinary decision or recommendation made by a faculty/college disciplinary committee or FTP Committee to the Senate Committee on Student Discipline (SCSD) THROUGH the first-instance committee within 7 working days of notification under Senate procedures (effective from AY2025-26, updated July 2026).

evidence.quote: Appeals in writing with full justifications may be lodged to the Senate Committee on Student Discipline through the disciplinary committee/the FTP Committee that deals with the case in the first instance, against the decision/recommendation made by the disciplinary committee/the FTP Committee, within seven working days after the student has received the notification. The appeal shall be handled in accordance with the “Procedures for Handling Student Disciplinary Cases” of the Senate Committee on Student Discipline. Late appeals shall not be considered. The case is closed if no appeal is received after the specified period.
